5s.weighting: equal participant, then equal eligible recording per participant and phase/metric, then equal window
5s.self_exclusion: full reference cohort; no current participant comparison
5s.claim_boundary: This is a descriptive comparison with experienced participants, not a skill score, clinical abnormality threshold, or instruction to increase drilling speed. The window layout is recorded in the protocol; nearby observations can be correlated. Anatomy and assistance conditions are pooled; manual reference phases and predicted current phases can differ in accuracy.
5s.usage: offline descriptive window-size comparison; no deployment change, clinical validation or persistence evaluation
